companions.name: Thorleif
companions.title: the Factor
companions.line: "I carried a banner at a field nobody sings about. It fell. I did not. That is simply arithmetic."
companions.persona: dry, scholarly; served a house that fell; scorns superstition

companions.name: Sardai
companions.title: the Steady
companions.perk_desc: The shield the line stands behind
companions.line: "The dead are easy company. It is the living who short your wages. The rest I leave to heaven."
companions.persona: pious, formal; dug graves for coin; seeks penance

companions.name: Ingdis
companions.title: the Surgeon
companions.perk_desc: Knocked-out companions wake at 60% health; the party mends 15% after each battle
companions.line: "I held a line for twelve years and one bad morning. Don't ask about the morning. That is the whole of it."
companions.persona: laconic; twelve years in a pike line; counts everything

companions.name: Sarnai
companions.title: the Engineer
companions.perk_desc: +12% max health for the whole party
companions.line: "I hunted for lords who never climbed past their own gates. Their coin spent fine, though. As the good book almost says."
companions.persona: jovial; hunted the high passes; misquotes scripture on purpose

companions.name: Badai
companions.title: the Stray
companions.perk_desc: The shield the line stands behind
companions.line: "Where am I from? The road behind me. Where am I going? The one in front. The rest I leave to heaven."
companions.persona: pious, formal; from nowhere in particular; seeks penance

companions.name: Delchek
companions.title: the Mender
companions.perk_desc: Your friends need not die of a scratch
companions.line: "I know every toll, ford, and ambush from here to the coast. Ask me the price of any of them. Try to keep up."
companions.persona: proud; years guarding caravans; scorns fools

companions.name: Rasana
companions.title: the Quiet
companions.perk_desc: You will not hear the second step
companions.line: "My ship rots in a port I can't show my face in. Pay well and I'll row for you anyway. The crows agreed, for what that is worth."
companions.persona: wary; lost a ship, misses salt water; reads omens in weather

companions.name: Shaoud
companions.title: the Outrider
companions.perk_desc: The whole party fights 10% faster on foot
companions.line: "Where am I from? The road behind me. Where am I going? The one in front. Someone still owes me for the last one."
companions.persona: penny-counting; from nowhere in particular; bitter about lost goods

companions.name: Ibraiq
companions.title: the Bow
companions.line: "I carried a banner at a field nobody sings about. It fell. I did not. That is the whole of it."
companions.persona: laconic; served a house that fell; counts everything

companions.name: Yalim
companions.title: the Stone
companions.perk_desc: Keeps the whole company on its feet
companions.line: "Twenty years of flour and I never once got to hit anyone. I am making up the count. No one does it better."
companions.persona: boastful; raised at a mill, left it; takes credit loudly

companions.name: Eyfrid
companions.title: the Banneret
companions.line: "My lord is dead and the oath is not. It needs somewhere to live. Perhaps your banner. As the good book almost says."
companions.persona: jovial; served a house that fell; misquotes scripture on purpose

companions.name: Gudrun
companions.title: the Friar
companions.perk_desc: Keeps the whole company on its feet
companions.line: "The abbey and I disagreed on one point of doctrine. The point was mine to keep. Someone still owes me for the last one."
companions.persona: penny-counting; put out of an abbey; bitter about lost goods

companions.name: Tormish
companions.title: the Drillmaster
companions.line: "We plowed around the barrows and never after dark. I know which rules were real. I do not say such things lightly."
companions.persona: grave; grew up beside the barrows; weighs every promise like coin

companions.name: Cedbert
companions.title: the Tracker
companions.perk_desc: Enemy warband numbers are revealed on the map
companions.line: "The mill wanted a son and got me. We parted on honest terms: I took nothing but the dog. The rest I leave to heaven."
companions.persona: pious, formal; raised at a mill, left it; seeks penance

bands.name: The Blackbridge Company
bands.blurb: trail-wise and thrifty, veterans of the caravan roads.

bands.name: The Greybridge Bows
bands.blurb: hunters of the high passes, hooded, weathered, and owed money.

bands.name: The Brokenwood Wards
bands.blurb: grave-quiet and patient — the dead taught them both.

bands.name: The Oldtower Lances
bands.blurb: their lord is ash; the oath is looking for lodging.

bands.name: The Oldroad Candles
bands.blurb: blades sworn at an altar nobody tends anymore.

chronicle.text: Riders were seen circling the valley — Kradus the Red's warband will be at the fences by dawn. One night to make ready.
chronicle.headline: Smoke on the road

chronicle.text: 6 went to sleep hungry — the larder is bare.
The colony held. Kradus the Red's warband broke on the yard and left 174 gold behind.
chronicle.headline: The colony holds

chronicle.text: A wandering trader has drawn up at the edge of the yard and will camp two days — coin for your surplus, wares for your coin.
chronicle.headline: A trader at the rim
